details:
Q1. Which part of this repository should be improved?
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan workflows
B. Implement / review_autofix / conflict-resolution workflows
C. Orchestrate / judge / poller / validation workflows
D. Docs / setup / workflow-wrapper behavior
E. A specific workflow, script, or file path — include its name/path in your reply (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug or incorrect behavior — include current vs expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Reduce runtime / token cost / API usage without changing behavior
C. Improve logs / alerts / status reporting / operator visibility
D. Improve documentation or setup guidance
E. Another concrete outcome — describe the exact before/after behavior (RECOMMENDED)
Q3. What evidence should we use as the source of truth?
Choices:
A. A workflow run URL or run ID/job name (and the consumer repo name if the run was not in this repo) (RECOMMENDED)
B. A PR number or issue number that shows the problem
C. A file path plus function/script name
D. No artifact exists; I will provide a precise description of the current behavior and the expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
